description:
If Crystalline Crawler has a +1/+1 counter on it, activate its first ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat step 1 until Crystalline Crawler has no +1/+1 counters on it.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Crystalline Crawler.
Crystalline Crawler dies, triggering its undying ability, returning it to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability, causing you to scry 1.
Repeat.
